title: These Sony Headphones Are Half Off Right Now
gist: Sony's previous-generation flagship WH-1000XM5 headphones are discounted 50-51 percent to $198 across Amazon, B&H Photo, and Sony's own store, with mid-range WH-CH720N and entry WH-CH520 models cut 44-46 percent, indicating aggressive channel-wide clearance of prior-gen Sony audio inventory now that the WH-1000XM6 is the current flagship.

insights.claim: The Sony WH-1000XM5 is selling at $198 versus a $400 list price — a 51 percent cut and the lowest price the reviewer has ever recorded for the model — after being superseded by the WH-1000XM6.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: A halving of the prior flagship's street price signals Sony is clearing legacy premium-ANC inventory to make room for the XM6, which compresses realized ASPs in the premium headphone category.
insights.quote: At 50 percent off, this is the lowest price I've seen on these headphones, making them an absolute steal.

insights.claim: The same $198 XM5 price appears simultaneously at Amazon, B&H Photo, and Sony's direct store, meaning the discount is set at the brand level rather than by a single retailer's promotion.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Uniform pricing across first-party and third-party channels points to a manufacturer-funded markdown, so the margin hit lands on Sony rather than the retailers.

insights.claim: Sony's mid-tier WH-CH720N is cut 46 percent to $98 and the budget WH-CH520 46 percent to $38, with identical pricing at Amazon, Walmart, and Sony.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Deep discounts across the entire ladder, not just the flagship, suggest broad inventory pressure in consumer audio rather than a single end-of-life event.

insights.claim: A $38 wireless headphone that the reviewer concedes has never been tested is still recommended purely on price, showing how far entry-level ANC-adjacent audio has commoditized.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Sub-$40 branded wireless headphones squeeze the no-name segment and cap pricing power for mid-market audio challengers.
insights.quote: WIRED hasn't tested the WH-CH520, but it’s one of Sony's most budget-friendly options, especially on sale for $38.

insights.claim: The recommendation rests explicitly on Sony's cross-category track record — headphones, soundbars, and OLED TVs — rather than on any single product's specification advantage.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Sony's durable reviewer goodwill is the asset that lets it discount hardware without eroding brand pricing power on the next generation.
insights.quote: Sony is one of the most reliable electronics brands we’ve tested, and its track record extends across a range of categories.
insights.locator: Sony is one of the most reliable electronics brands
